description: This file manages an announce queue system, including queue state, enqueueing, draining, and error handling, for a messaging or notification system within a larger application.

classes.name: AnnounceQueueItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the announce queue, including message prompt, metadata, and origin context.

classes.name: AnnounceQueueSettings
classes.description: Configuration settings for an announce queue, including mode, debounce time, capacity, and drop policy.

classes.name: AnnounceQueueState
classes.description: Internal state of an announce queue, including items, mode, settings, and failure count.

methods.name: resetAnnounceQueuesForTests
methods.description: Resets all announce queues, clearing their state for testing purposes.

methods.name: getAnnounceQueue
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an announce queue with specified settings and send function.

methods.name: hasAnnounceCrossChannelItems
methods.description: Checks if any items in the queue are cross-channel based on their origin context.

methods.name: scheduleAnnounceDrain
methods.description: Schedules the draining process for a specific announce queue.

methods.name: enqueueAnnounce
methods.description: Adds an item to the announce queue and triggers drain scheduling.
